claim: At NEX launch paging is unlocked, so a boot model that assumed 7FFD locked rejected every hardware-proven build.

evidence.text: Maintainers' note: hardware-proven builds were rejected by a model assuming 7FFD locked at launch.
A "7FFD locked at launch" model rejected every hardware-proven build; docs/BRIEFING.md adds that all hardware-tested builds page with legacy writes without unlocking.
evidence.quote: Model the NEX launch state from hardware evidence
